feature-approval-required: Tlogela dikarolo tse dintšhafatso tsa WeKan di di tsenyang di timilwe go fitlha motsamaisi a di bulela
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu ya boto → Tshosobanyo e bontsha se motho mongwe le mongwe a se dirileng mo botong mo letsatsing kgotsa bekeng ya bofelo, le se se fetilweng ke nako.
feature-pilot-users: Badirisi ba teko ba ba bonang le dikarolo tse di timilweng
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Maina a badirisi, a kgaogantswe ka dikhoma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Di bolokilwe. Maina ano a badirisi ga a bonwa:
feature-preview-admins: Batsamaisi ba bona dikarolo tse di timilweng gore ba di leke pele
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu ya boto → Melao e tshitshinya melao go tswa mo go se batho ba se dirang ka seatla gantsi.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Go batla gotlhe go tlhaloganya dipolelwana tse di jaaka "dikarata tsa me tse di fetilweng ke nako".
feature-since-last-visit: Go tloga ketelo ya gago ya bofelo
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu ya boto → Go tloga ketelo ya gago ya bofelo e bontsha se ba bangwe ba se fetotseng mo botong.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khalendara le khalendara ya diboto tse dintsi.
feature-views-chat-desc: Boto jaaka lefelo la tiro la puisano: mafelo a tiro, diboto, ditsela, manaane le dikarata jaaka setlhare sa dikanale, karata fa gare le dikakgelo tsa yone jaaka melaetsa ya puisano.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Dikarata tse di tshwanang mo ditlhopheng di le mmalwa tse di nang le maina tsa dikholomo - ka go wediwa, botlhokwa, kgato kgotsa sengwe se sengwe - di sutisiwa magareng ga dikholomo ka go goga.
feature-views-email-desc: Boto jaaka lebokose la poso: lenaane la imeile ke Lebokose la tse di tsenang, manaane ke difoldara, ditshwao ke ditshwao, mme maloko a kwala le go araba imeile go tswa mo atereseng ya boto.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Tiro e e setseng le e e weditsweng, kelelo e e kgobokaneng, nako ya modikologo le ya go isa, selekanyo sa tiro e e weditsweng, nako e tiro e ntseng e le teng, dikgoreletsi, Monte Carlo le dilekanyo tse dingwe tsa kelelo.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Diponagalo tse tharo tsa tšhate ya Gantt.
feature-views-map-desc: Dikarata jaaka matshwao mo setshwantshong se se tsentsweng.
feature-views-overview-desc: Dipalopalo, go kgaoganya ka ditlhopha go ya ka motho yo o abetsweng, thulaganyo ya tsela, boto ya taolo le boto e kgolo.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Lenaane la ditiro tsa sedirisiwa, dipaka tse dikhutshwane tsa tiro, pego ya paka ya tiro le lebelo.
feature-views-table-desc: Boto jaaka tafole ya dikarata tse di ka rulaganngwang.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Boto jaaka setshedi sa mathata sa GitHub kgotsa Gitea: dikarata jaaka mathata, ditshwao le maemo a botlhokwa, dikakgelo jaaka puisano, tse di tshwaraganeng jaaka difaele, le hisetori ya boto e e nang le go busetsa.
filter-no-due-date: Ga go na letlha la bofelo

set-selected-unstarred: Tlosa naledi mo dibotong tse di tlhophilweng
